scenarios.title: Desktop DocWen operations and Vault-safe commits
steps: Exercise the four imperative settings tabs, contextual help cards, and capability discovery
Open every Formats example in DocWen from the file explorer; inspect the selected-file controls in single and batch modes, including repeated opens and unsupported-action explanations
Run proofread, conversion, validation, and numbering against the deterministic notes
Inject unsaved-buffer and concurrent-target conflicts before output commit
expected: Typed capability failures remain visible and successful empty results remain empty
Only a confirmed staged result may replace an allowed target
Cancellation, conflict, and unload leave no child process or transaction residue
Every open request selects the requested file without silently executing or reusing a previous input
